127spgg|Scope rules to implement (Nix semantics, exactly):
128lkca|- Scopes: RootScope (whole file), LetScope per let, LambdaScope per lambda
129hkwa|  (params, formals, at-name), RecScope per rec attrset. Attrsets (non-rec) bind
130upuv|  nothing for resolution. with creates a WithScope over its body only.
131wgig|- Bindings in scope order: let bindings sequential (binding i visible in
132hgmv|  bindings i+1..n and the body; NOT in its own value, NOT in earlier values).
133ibiz|  inherit (x) a b; in a let adds a,b as LetBinding-kind entries at that
134llnb|  position. rec attrset: all attr names visible in all values (recursion).
135ztne|  formals: param i visible in defaults of j>i and in the body. at-name visible
136jmrd|  in the body. Lambda ident param visible in the body (NOT in itself).
137yaqm|  inherit (x) a b; in an attrset adds a,b as InheritName entries; in rec, as
138pxcn|  RecAttr entries.
139eqij|- References: ident tokens in EXPRESSION position. NOT attrpath elements
140vywx|  (binding position or select field), NOT keyword tokens, NOT inherit names,
141obot|  NOT formals. Interpolations ARE expression positions.
142ncxn|- Resolution of a reference at position P: walk scopes outward from the
143crvq|  innermost scope containing P. First lexical binding whose scope rules make
144brpf|  it visible at P wins (respecting let sequentiality and formals defaults).
145vusl|  If NO lexical binding found on the whole path, fall back to with-scopes:
146mqos|  the innermost with-scope whose body contains P is the candidate; record
147gpof|  via_with = that with's index. (Statically we cannot know whether the with
148urbe|  actually provides the name — via_with only records the innermost candidate.)

150enor|  path_range (the argument expr's range). Also record for builtins.import
151obox|  (func = Select with base Ident builtins and attrpath [import]).

153qdxn|  once (RefCell) on first accessor call and is shared thereafter.

155vyvv|  nodes, never panic.
